licensure.disciplinary_grounds.rationale: These nine buckets map cleanly onto the dominant disciplinary ground types across state public accountancy statutes: fraudulent license procurement, practice-level misconduct, criminal history, reciprocal discipline from other jurisdictions or agencies, regulatory/professional-standards violations, practicing without authority, general fitness/character concerns, continuing-education and peer-review requirements, and administrative/procedural non-compliance.

profession_specific.attest_services_type.rationale: The data clusters tightly around the five canonical attest/assurance engagement types defined by standard-setting bodies (SAS audits, SSARS reviews, SSARS compilations, SSAE prospective-information examinations, and SSAE attestation/agreed-upon procedures), plus a distinct PCAOB public-company bucket, a small government-auditing bucket (GAGAS/municipal), and a residual catch-all for broad or unclassified assurance references.
